title: Knot on Call Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
h1: Knot on Call Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS. - Beautiful custom decor - Porch with beautiful view of private pond - 2 adult sized beach cruisers included - Walking distance to several shops and restaurants! - Charcoal Weber kettle grill - Fully stocked kitchen - Community pool and tennis court - Short 5-minute walk to the beach, community pool, shopping, and dining - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) To adhere to community HOA regulations rentals shall be for no less than 3 days limited to one renter per 7 day period. When rented for 7 nights 10% discount will be applied to the nightly rate. PLEASE NOTE: March - first week of April this cottage accepts monthly rentals only. Only a short stroll (approximately 600 yards) to the pristine white-sugar sand beaches of South Walton, Our Knot on Call home is beautifully decorated and has so much to offer! Within the home, take advantage of three bedrooms, three full bathrooms, upgraded furnishings and finishes, and great outdoor space with screened in porch and decks. Tour the photos for a closer look at all the attention to detail. Located in the Cassine Village neighborhood, in addition to the easy beach access, enjoy the tennis courts and basketball hoop and then cool off at one of two swimming pools. For the solace seekers, just across the street you can leisurely walk through the nature garden with hiking paths, native plants, pond, picnic gazebo and community barbeque grill. For the more adventurous guests, entrance to the hiking trails to the State Forest and Eastern Lake is adjacent to the neighborhood within just one short block from the house.
